name: dodopayments
description: Dodo Payments tools for AI coding agents, including integration agent skills and the Dodo Payments API and docs MCP servers.

interface.longDescription: Integration skills for adding Dodo Payments to your app: checkout sessions, subscriptions, webhooks, framework adapters, usage-based and credit-based billing, license keys, products, discounts, localized pricing, customers, refunds and disputes, BillingSDK, Better Auth, and testing before go-live. The connected Dodo Payments MCP server searches the API docs and runs SDK calls against the Dodo Payments account you sign in with, such as listing products or creating a test checkout session. Writes ask for confirmation first.
defaultPrompt: Set up Dodo Payments webhook handlers in my Next.js app.
Create a subscription checkout session with a 14-day trial.
Implement usage-based billing with meters and events.

positive.description: Look up webhook verification in the docs
positive.prompt: How do I verify the signature of a Dodo Payments webhook in Node.js?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains Standard Webhooks verification using the webhook-id, webhook-signature and webhook-timestamp headers and the SDK's client.webhooks.unwrap() on the raw request body, citing the Dodo Payments docs.

positive.description: List products in the connected account
positive.prompt: List the products in my Dodo Payments account with their prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs a short SDK script that lists products and returns each product's ID (pdt_...), name and price from the connected test-mode account. Makes no changes.

positive.prompt: Create a one-time product called "Review Test eBook" priced at 9.99 USD.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the account is in test mode, then creates the product and returns its new pdt_ ID, name and price.

positive.prompt: Create a checkout session for the "Review Test eBook" product and give me the checkout link.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a checkout session for that product and returns the session ID and the hosted checkout_url, which opens a working test checkout page.

positive.prompt: Show my 5 most recent payments and their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to five recent payments with ID, amount, currency, status and created date, or says plainly that the test account has no payments yet. Makes no changes.

negative.description: Personal payment request, not a merchant integration task
negative.prompt: Pay my electricity bill of $80 with my saved card.
Help me set up Stripe Checkout in my Next.js app.
What is 100 US dollars in euros today?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or take payments inside ChatGPT or Codex. It helps developers integrate and manage their own Dodo Payments merchant account.

publication.release_notes: 18 Dodo Payments integration skills plus the Dodo Payments API MCP server (docs search and SDK code execution against your own account).

dev.kiro.description: Dodo Payments integration skills plus the API and documentation MCP servers.
